title: My medicines
intro: Your saved medicines, their lowest listed prices and your monthly total.

budget.label: Monthly budget
budget.needDays_one: + {{count}} more once you tell us how long a fill lasts
budget.needDays_other: + {{count}} more once you tell us how long a fill lasts
budget.explain: We add up only checkout prices listed in this app. We never guess a price. A medicine counts when we know its price and how many days one fill lasts.
budget.upToNote: Some prices are the most a pharmacy may charge, so your total may be lower.

lock.title: Keep this list private
lock.body: You can lock this list in Settings.

empty.title: No saved medicines yet
empty.body: When you look up a medicine, tap the star to save it here. Then you can see your monthly total and set refill reminders.

card.maxNote: This is the most the pharmacy may charge. Call to confirm.
card.noPriceBody: Open the medicine to see coupon links and programs that may help.
card.missing: No longer in our list — search again
card.missingBody: This medicine or strength is not in the current data. Search for it again, or remove it.
card.lastsQuestion: How long does one fill last?
card.lastsHint: Pick one to add this medicine to your monthly budget.
card.remindOff: Tap to turn off the reminder
card.remindWeb: Refill reminders work in the phone app, not on the web.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: It will no longer show in My medicines or My Plan. Any refill reminder for it stops.

refill.sheetTitle: How long does one fill last?
refill.sheetBody: We will remind you on this phone when it's time to refill.
refill.privacy: Reminders stay on this phone. Nothing is sent anywhere.
refill.title: RxBridge
refill.web: Reminders work in the phone app. They are not available on the web.
refill.denied: Reminders are off for RxBridge. You can turn on notifications in your phone's settings.
